rules: Every reachable state is rendered and individually inspected with original screenshot and exact artifact/source/browser bindings.

Use native controls for state transitions; synthetic DOM edits cannot qualify normal interaction. User CSS text-spacing, deliberate failed request routing and malformed protocol messages are separately labeled adversarial probes.

No document horizontal overflow beyond1CSSpixel, no lost text/actions, no overlap occluding interactive labels, no inaccessible name, no serious/critical axe violations. Normal text contrast >=4.5:1; large text >=3:1; control/focus indication >=3:1. Focus not obscured and visible in real Tab modality.
Long names preserve complete input/status data and wrap status. Empty/whitespace names disable create. Save emits exact current project; edit restores Create.

Each native switch label/click/Space/Enter toggles once. Each rhythm option selectable with keyboard and pointer; Escape dismisses popup without unwanted state change. Slider Home0/End100/Arrow increments match native semantics and progress visualization.

All4featuredframes display latest mode/density after ready regardless of lazy order. Parent changes preserve sameFrame and actual childstate. Invalidsource/origin/variant readiness sends no settings; positive control must prove listener instrumentation.

Capture settled viewport sections plus fullpage. Fullpage original cannot prove unloaded preview state; individually scroll frames, wait ready and repaint, then capture. Reproducible paint omissions stay open; transient omissions recorded with fresh clean retake.

Exact released browser versions and platforms must be recorded. Playwright engine WebKit is supplemental, never Safari/iOS acceptance. Native zoom requires actual browser zoom/getZoom proof; viewport/DPR/CSS scale are not substitutes.
Independent reviewer reruns and views evidence on same immutableartifact; source repairs invalidate affected evidence and require fresh artifact. No shared-source editing by item worker.
